text:
Priya: short sync  we need a clean post-launch play for next two sprints: balance immediate customer fixes vs. polish enhancements.
Ben: +1. recommend a simple decision grid so triage is fast.
Carlos: grid idea: (customer-blocking? yes/no) x (reproducible? yes/no) x (scope dev-days). if blocking & reproducible -> fast-lane.
Tara: add a perf axis: any change that increases p99 by >15% or error-rate by >3% -> escalate into fast-lane regardless of customer count.
Aisha: customers want predictability. propose "48/5": 48h ack, 5 business day plan, delivery target 2 sprints. exceptions: infra/security.
Priya: agree. also rotate a fast-lane engineer each sprint (1 engineer) to own triage and quick patches.
Ben: rollout guardrails: canary staircase: 3% -> 20% -> 75% -> 100% with checks at each step. ops-bot will post signals.
ops-bot: canary pipeline created: canary/staircase-v3. smoke checks queued. :robot_face:
Carlos: release checklist for any fast-lane change:
- unit & integration smoke
- canary smoke (latency & errors)
- customer pilot if tagged
- quick quality eval vs baseline
- designated rollback window + owner
Tara: rollback owner = ops oncall + release engineer; put explicit name on the ticket during cut.
Priya: owners template: quality=Carlos, comms=Ben, release=Tara, monitoring=ops-oncall. fill in person per card.
Aisha: grooming tweak: pre-tag backlog items with tags: customer-impact, dev-days, acceptance-criteria. run a 15m pre-groom to select top 8 for sprint.
Ben: acceptance criteria must include a telemetry assertion (e.g., no >5% increase in error rate) besides functional tests.
Carlos: for temporary model changes (quant/ft), require eval checks: hallucination delta <= baseline + 2% and accuracy within tolerance.
Priya: escalation rule: do not broaden scope if >1 open P1 OR any active customer-blocking regression.
Aisha: pilot volunteers: Acme, Nuvem, BrightData. we'll flip canary flags and gather feedback in shared doc.
Tara: timeline: by EOD add dev-day estimate and acceptance criteria to each card. confirm at 11am stand.
Ben: adding estimates now.
Carlos: updating runbook with checklist and canary steps.
ops-bot: reminder set for 11:00  Post-launch iteration confirm.
Priya: thanks team. keep the fast-lane lean. :thumbsup:
